objective: Go home to Emberwood: Hisame has sent word after dark
title: The Seventh Lantern
summary: A black paper crane lands in the yard, and the people who forged the Five-Nature Seal ask for it back.

steps.title: The Seventh Lantern
steps.sub: Seven nights after the Five Winds

say: Seven lanterns, one for each night since the mountain. Hisame says it's a custom. I think she just likes lanterns.

lines: It is a custom. One light for every night the Seal holds. The academy has kept it since before there was an academy.
Seven nights. Is that a lot?
It is more than anyone has kept it in a long while.
Black paper. Nobody at this academy folds black paper.
It was already folded when it landed on the lantern. And it landed in the one you hadn't lit.

say: Good evening. I am Mikage, envoy of the Hollow Court. You will not have heard of us. That was rather the point of us.
Four hundred years ago the Court forged the Five-Nature Seal. A child from a small island has just finished it, and it wears her like a borrowed coat.
You are four hundred years late to be this polite.
Courtesy is the one thing we have in abundance. Bring the Seal to the Five Winds by the new moon, and we will take the burden from you.

lines: It isn't a burden. It's the reason the mountain stopped screaming.
It is a door. You have been standing in front of it for a week, and you have not yet asked what is on the other side.
Is she going to say she'll ask again, less politely? Because Chiyo told me about that line.
Then you have been warned by better storytellers than I. Hollow, to me.

beats.text: Hold the yard against the Court's clones

lines: Good. You did not flinch. The Court dislikes being wrong about people.
The new moon, at the Five Winds. Come, or we will come for the one thing that makes you who you are.
The Hollow Court was a story for apprentices. Be good, or the Court takes your name.
I was told it as a child, and I told it to Asahi, and to you. I did not think I was describing anyone.
We find out what they really want. Tsumugi's Watch has kept records on them for two hundred years. Start there, {name}.
